name_zh: 马来亚·东姑阿都拉曼：温和独立与联邦种族平衡
name_en: Malaya Tunku Abdul Rahman: Moderate Independence & Federal Racial Balance
description_zh: 东姑阿都拉曼 (1903-1990) 马来亚首任首相 (1957-1970)，通过谈判而非武装斗争实现独立，建立马来西亚联邦(1963)，设计种族平衡宪法(马来特权/华印公民权)，被誉为独立之父。
description_en: Tunku Abdul Rahman (1903-1990) Malaya first PM (1957-1970), achieved independence through negotiation not armed struggle, established Malaysia Federation (1963), designed racial balance constitution (Malay privileges/Chinese Indian citizenship), hailed as Father of Independence.
reason_zh: 东姑代表东南亚温和过渡独立的典范，展示了精英协商如何在多种族社会中建立权力分享契约，避免了印尼越南式暴力独立代价，奠定马来西亚联邦制基础。
reason_en: Tunku represents Southeast Asia moderate transition independence paradigm, demonstrating how elite negotiation builds power-sharing compact in multiracial society, avoiding Indonesia/Vietnam violent independence costs, laying Malaysia federal foundation.
steps_zh: 研究东姑早年王室背景与英国教育精英路径
分析1955年大选胜利与1957年独立谈判
探讨1963年马来西亚联邦成立与新加坡分离(1965)
评估种族暴乱(1969)与东姑下台权力交接
总结温和独立联邦种族平衡模式对东南亚的示范意义
steps_en: Study Tunku early royal background and British education elite path
Analyze 1955 election victory and 1957 independence negotiation
Explore 1963 Malaysia Federation formation and Singapore separation (1965)
Evaluate 1969 racial riots and Tunku resignation power transfer
Summarize moderate independence federal racial balance model demonstration for Southeast Asia
expected_zh: 理解精英协商独立如何构建多种族权力分享契约，掌握联邦制与种族平衡宪法设计的核心逻辑，评估其对马来西亚长期稳定的奠基与局限。
expected_en: Understand how negotiated independence builds multiracial power-sharing compact, grasp federalism and racial balance constitutional design core logic, evaluate its foundational role and limits for Malaysia long-term stability.
case_zh: 1955 大选胜利；1957 独立；1963 联邦成立；1965 新加坡分离；1970 下台。温和独立联邦种族平衡范式永存。
case_en: 1955 election win; 1957 independence; 1963 Federation formed; 1965 Singapore separation; 1970 resignation. Moderate independence federal racial balance paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Negotiated independence; federalism; racial balance; Singapore separation
